briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push AGI timelines as compute arms race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid record funding. Regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agents. Prompt injection and multi-agent security remain top priorities.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning; xAI deployed Grok-4 on 200k H100 cluster; DeepSeek-V4 and Meta Llama-4 variants launched this week. Anthropic Claude 4 Opus benchmarks show 12% gains on agentic tasks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced new 100k GPU clusters in Texas and Nevada. TSMC 2nm AI chips enter volume production; energy demand for training runs now exceeds 5GW globally.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese state-backed consortium before 2028?
